title: Deep learning model for the prediction of all-cause mortality among long term care people in China: a prospective cohort study.
summary: The primary prospective-cohort study uses an ANN survival model on 42,353 disabled long-term-care participants and validates mortality-risk strata on a later cohort subset. The reported risk groups are limited to this Chinese pilot-city population and do not establish care benefit.
